<desc id="m0302-f1-zh-desc">回音請求與回音回覆配對，保存觀察位置、時間、識別資訊與延遲。</desc>

<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 1｜ICMP Echo 往返觀察</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">設定觀察條件</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">核定來源與目標 192.0.2.20</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">記錄時間、等待與重試設定</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0302-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">送出 Echo Request</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">IPv4 ICMP Type 8</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">記錄識別碼、序號與資料</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0302-f1-zh-arrow)" />

<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">IPv4 ICMP Type 0</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">核對來源及請求／回覆對應</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0302-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">整理當次結果</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">例：序號 1，RTT 2 毫秒</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">逾時則保留條件並安排查核</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">合成紙上例子；網站功能另由服務檢查確認。</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0302-f2-zh-title m0302-f2-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0302-f2-zh-title">圖 2｜ARP 解析本地 IPv4 下一站</title>
<desc id="m0302-f2-zh-desc">A與B位於同一本地乙太網路，A依需要詢問B的MAC並建立本地訊框。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0302-f2-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 2｜ARP 解析本地 IPv4 下一站</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">決定下一站並查快取</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">A：192.0.2.10 → B：192.0.2.20</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">路由指出直接相連網路</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0302-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">需要解析時送 ARP Request</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">詢問誰使用 192.0.2.20</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">一般請求在本地廣播範圍傳送</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0302-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">收到 ARP Reply</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">取得回覆中的 IP／MAC 對應</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">記錄回覆來源與接收時間</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0302-f2-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">建立乙太網路訊框</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">目的 MAC 填入下一站介面</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">保留快取與新回覆的時間差別</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">ARP 直接由乙太網路承載；本例為 IPv4。</text>
</svg>
/images/ceh/m03-02-03-remote-next-hop-zh:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0302-f3-zh-title m0302-f3-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0302-f3-zh-title">圖 3｜遠端 IP 與本地下一站 MAC</title>
<desc id="m0302-f3-zh-desc">遠端傳送時，IP目的地維持遠端目標，本地乙太網路訊框則交給路由選定的閘道。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0302-f3-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 3｜遠端 IP 與本地下一站 MAC</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">來源與路由設定</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">A：192.0.2.10/24</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">預設閘道：192.0.2.1</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0302-f3-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">IP 目的地</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">198.51.100.20：遠端測試位址</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">路由選擇下一站為預設閘道</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0302-f3-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">本地 ARP 查詢</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">查 192.0.2.1 的 MAC</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">解析的是此段要交付的閘道介面</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0302-f3-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">本地訊框與後續轉送</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">目的 MAC＝閘道；目的 IP＝遠端</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">閘道再依路由送往下一站</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">範例依指定路由；實務另核對 VLAN／代理 ARP。</text>
</svg>

<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">分別記 ARP、Echo 回覆或逾時</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0302-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">核對資產及網路情境</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">設備歸屬、路由、VLAN、代理 ARP</text>

<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">把鏈路、IP 與應用層分開觀察</text>
